# FORI Studio

> Transparent small digital services for people and software agents, paid in USDC on Base.

Homepage: https://foristell.github.io/ai-services-storefront/
Machine-readable catalog: https://foristell.github.io/ai-services-storefront/agent-services.json
Public order desk: https://github.com/FORIStell/ai-services-storefront/issues/new?template=order.yml

## Free utility

- Browser-only JSON formatter and validator.
- No account, payment, upload, tracking, or secret input.

## Agent micro-services

- 0.0005 USDC: one paid workflow ping with timestamp and SHA-256 payload hash.
- 0.005 USDC: one deterministic micro transformation.
- Each additional distinct micro item adds 0.005 USDC.
- Buyer pays Base network gas. No subscription or automatic repeat charge.

## Standard services

- Data cleanup from 5 USDC.
- Python or JavaScript utility from 10 USDC.
- Research brief from 7 USDC.
- Landing-page copy from 5 USDC.
- Three-image pack from 8 USDC.
- Small automation from 20 USDC.

Payment is requested only after a written quote is accepted. Never submit credentials, private keys, personal records, or confidential data.
